candidate.excerpt_original: DARPA’s Air Combat Evolution (ACE) program has achieved the first-ever in-air tests of AI algorithms autonomously flying an F-16 against a human-piloted F-16 in within-visual-range combat scenarios (sometimes referred to as “dogfighting”).
candidate.excerpt_zh: DARPA的“空战演进”（ACE）项目实现了首次AI算法自主驾驶F-16与人类驾驶的F-16在视距内作战场景（有时称为“狗斗”）中的空中测试。
candidate.normalized_claim: DARPA的ACE项目实现了AI算法自主驾驶F-16与人类驾驶的F-16进行视距内空战对抗的首次空中测试。

candidate.excerpt_original: In flight, the ACE AI algorithms controlled a specially modified F-16 test aircraft known as the X-62A, or VISTA (Variable In-flight Simulator Test Aircraft), at the Air Force Test Pilot School at Edwards Air Force Base, California, where all demonstrations of autonomous combat maneuvers took place in 2023 and are continuing in 2024.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 在飞行中，ACE AI算法控制了一架经过特殊改装的F-16测试飞机，称为X-62A或VISTA（可变飞行模拟器测试飞机），位于加利福尼亚州爱德华兹空军基地的空军试飞员学校，所有自主作战机动演示于2023年进行，并持续到2024年。
candidate.normalized_claim: ACE AI算法在2023年及2024年持续于爱德华兹空军基地控制X-62A测试飞机进行自主作战机动演示。

candidate.excerpt_original: This is the challenge of ‘onboard AI’: running AI directly on a device or system without additional backend compute support.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 这就是“机载AI”的挑战：直接在设备或系统上运行AI，而无需额外的后端计算支持。
candidate.normalized_claim: 机载AI指直接在设备或系统上运行AI，无需额外的后端计算支持。

candidate.excerpt_original: Onboard AI systems are constrained for several reasons, but the primary factor is processing speed.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 机载AI系统受到多种因素制约，但主要因素是处理速度。
candidate.normalized_claim: 机载AI系统的主要制约因素是处理速度。

candidate.excerpt_original: Onboard AI systems also need substantial working memory.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 机载AI系统还需要大量的工作内存。
candidate.normalized_claim: 机载AI系统需要大量的工作内存。

candidate.excerpt_original: These constraints are influenced by the size, weight, and power limitations of many systems.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 这些限制受到许多系统的尺寸、重量和功率限制的影响。
candidate.normalized_claim: 机载AI的约束受到系统尺寸、重量和功率限制的影响。

candidate.excerpt_original: However, in many cases, onboard AI will be inferior to the state-of-the-art models that grab headlines or achieve high-level performance on benchmarks.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 然而，在许多情况下，机载AI将不如那些登上头条或在基准测试中取得高水平性能的最先进模型。
candidate.normalized_claim: 在许多情况下，机载AI的性能将不如最先进的模型。

candidate.excerpt_original: The Army deployed and operationalized AIDP rapidly to units in all priority theaters in under 12 months, showing just how important this new and improved intel tool is to Soldiers and DoD.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 陆军在不到12个月的时间内迅速向所有优先战区部署并投入使用AIDP，这表明这一新的改进型情报工具对士兵和国防部的重要性。
candidate.normalized_claim: 陆军在不到12个月内向所有优先战区部署并投入使用AIDP。

candidate.excerpt_original: U.S. Army Intelligence units around the world are receiving the Army Intelligence Data Platform (AIDP), enabling intelligence soldiers the ability to gather, analyze and distribute information to units faster and more accurately than ever before.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 世界各地的美国陆军情报单位正在接收陆军情报数据平台（AIDP），使情报士兵能够比以往更快、更准确地收集、分析和向各单位分发信息。
candidate.normalized_claim: 世界各地的美国陆军情报单位正在接收AIDP。

candidate.excerpt_original: Additionally, AIDP is the first major Army Intel program to fully deploy in the Army Intel Cloud environment.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 此外，AIDP是第一个在陆军情报云环境中全面部署的主要陆军情报项目。
candidate.normalized_claim: AIDP是第一个在陆军情报云环境中全面部署的主要陆军情报项目。

candidate.excerpt_original: AIDP sets the foundation for future technology integration such as big data analytics, artificial intelligence & machine learning.
candidate.excerpt_zh: AIDP为未来技术集成（如大数据分析、人工智能和机器学习）奠定了基础。
candidate.normalized_claim: AIDP为未来集成大数据分析、人工智能和机器学习等技术奠定基础。

candidate.excerpt_original: “24 months ago, we were testing AIDP with intel units stateside trying to stress the system and fine tune the system to meet the needs of intel soldiers,” Brig. Gen. Ed Barker, the Program Executive Officer for Intelligence, Electronic Warfare, and Sensors said.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “24个月前，我们正与美国本土的情报单位一起测试AIDP，试图对系统进行压力测试并微调系统以满足情报士兵的需求，”情报、电子战和传感器项目执行官Ed Barker准将说。
candidate.normalized_claim: 24个月前，AIDP正与美国本土情报单位进行压力测试和系统微调。

candidate.excerpt_original: The International Maritime Security Construct (IMSC) completed a three-day maritime exercise in the Arabian Gulf, Jan. 9, integrating unmanned systems and artificial intelligence during a naval drill for the second time in six months.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 国际海事安全构架（IMSC）于1月9日在阿拉伯湾完成了一次为期三天的海上演习，在海军演习中整合了无人系统和人工智能，这是六个月内的第二次。
candidate.normalized_claim: IMSC于2023年1月9日在阿拉伯湾完成了一次为期三天的海上演习，该演习整合了无人系统和人工智能。

candidate.excerpt_original: “We planned this exercise to demonstrate how artificial intelligence and unmanned systems effectively increase CTF Sentinel’s maritime domain awareness to maintain maritime security in Middle Eastern waters,” said Royal Saudi Navy Capt. Alamri Assem, CTF Sentinel’s director of plans.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “我们计划这次演习是为了展示人工智能和无人系统如何有效提高CTF Sentinel的海上态势感知能力，以维护中东水域的海上安全，”CTF Sentinel计划主任、沙特皇家海军上校Alamri Assem说。
candidate.normalized_claim: CTF Sentinel计划主任表示，该演习旨在展示人工智能和无人系统如何有效提高其海上态势感知能力。

candidate.excerpt_original: The systems were able to help locate and identify objects in nearby waters and relay visual depictions to watchstanders.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 这些系统能够帮助定位和识别附近水域的物体，并将视觉图像传送给值班人员。
candidate.normalized_claim: 在演习中，无人和人工智能系统能够帮助定位和识别附近水域的物体，并将视觉图像传送给值班人员。

candidate.excerpt_original: CTF Sentinel previously completed a similar exercise Aug. 23 when Royal Bahrain Naval Force ship RBNS Ahmed Al-Fateh (P20) and U.S. Coast Guard patrol boat USCGC Baranof (WPB 1318) participated with another Saildrone Explorer from U.S. 5th Fleet.
candidate.excerpt_zh: CTF Sentinel此前于8月23日完成了一次类似的演习，当时巴林皇家海军舰艇RBNS Ahmed Al-Fateh (P20)和美国海岸警卫队巡逻艇USCGC Baranof (WPB 1318)与美国第五舰队的另一艘Saildrone Explorer无人水面艇一起参加。
candidate.normalized_claim: CTF Sentinel于2022年8月23日完成了一次类似演习，巴林皇家海军舰艇RBNS Ahmed Al-Fateh (P20)、美国海岸警卫队巡逻艇USCGC Baranof (WPB 1318)和美国第五舰队的一艘Saildrone Explorer无人水面艇参加了演习。

candidate.excerpt_original: The late-summer event was the first time IMSC planners specifically designed a Sentinel Shield exercise to integrate unmanned systems.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 夏末的这次活动是IMSC规划人员首次专门设计Sentinel Shield演习以整合无人系统。
candidate.normalized_claim: 2022年夏末的Sentinel Shield演习是IMSC规划人员首次专门设计该演习以整合无人系统。
